sammannisu: [ saṃ + mana + ya + uṃ ] (kri) CL=7 They honored and acknowledged or respected and regarded.
sammannāpetu: [ saṃ + mana + ya + ṇape + tuṃ ] (bya) CL=7 To honor and acknowledge.
sammantayisu: [ saṃ + manta + ṇaya + uṃ ] (kri) CL=7 See - Sammantesuṃ.
sammantesu: [ saṃ + manta + ṇe + uṃ ] (kri) CL=7 They discussed together or consulted.
sammappadhānapaṭisayutta: [ sammappadhāna + paṭisaṃyutta ]  CL=9 (the Sutta) associated with the correct application of effort or right effort.
sammeyyu: [ samu + ya + eyyuṃ. Sammati-mha. ] (kri) CL=7 They should be calm.
sammoditu: [ saṃ + muda + tuṃ ] (bya) CL=7 To rejoice together. See - Sammoditabba.
sammodisu: [ saṃ + muda + uṃ ] (kri) CL=7 They had a friendly conversation.
sammohadhasaka: [ sammoha+ dhaṃsaka ] (ti) CL=7 The wisdom that eradicates or dispels delusion. See - Sammohadhaṃsakañāṇasahita.
sammohadhasakañāṇa: [ sammohadhaṃsaka + ñāṇa ] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that eradicates or dispels delusion. See - Sammohadhaṃsakañāṇasahita.
sammohadhasakañāṇasahita: [ sammohadhaṃsakañāṇa + sahita ] (ti) CL=7 A mental state (cittuppāda) that arises together with the wisdom that eradicates delusion.
sammohaviddhasana: [ sammoha + viddhaṃsana ] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who destroys delusion. (Na) (2) The destruction of delusion.
sammosaviddhasana: [ sammosa + viddhaṃsana ] (na) CL=7 Destruction of forgetfulness.
sammutimanāpasavibhāga: [ sammutimanāpa + saṃvibhāga ] (pu) CL=7 Analyzes the pleasing or agreeable (iṭṭharūpa) due to conventional designation.
sammādiṭṭhikapasasana: [ sammādiṭṭhika + pasaṃsana ] (na) CL=7 Praising those who possess the right view.
sammāsavara: [ sammā + saṃvara = saṃ + vara + a. ] (pu) CL=7 Correctly restraining or controlling. See - Sammāsaṃvarasusira.
sammāsavarasusira: [ sammāsaṃvara + susira ] (na) CL=7 A hollow or cavity characterized by correct restraint.
